subject: AWS CPPO — reseller credit activation pathways & sequencing
messages:
From: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS CPPO activation: credit mechanics + sequencing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on — wanted to start the thread to align on how ResellerCo expects CPPO credits to be consumed and what activation sequencing looks like from your side. High level asks:

- Confirm whether credits are applied at invoice settlement vs. entitlement time.
- Outline the handoff steps we need to automate in the reseller portal so downstream SKUs are enabled automatically once PO is accepted.
- Any DocuSign or entity mapping prerequisites we should include in our internal checklist.

We have a tight window: customer procurement wants to push the PO to AWS on 11/12 (next Friday). Can we scope a minimal activation path that lets the initial purchase go live without waiting on full entitlement automation?

Attachment: resell-credit-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) — I attached our suggested mapping of sku -> credit bucket to illustrate the ask.

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
ResellerCo
ops@cloudresell.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO activation: credit mechanics + sequencing

Alicia — thanks for the clear outline and the matrix, that helps. Proposed quick plan below to unblock the 11/12 PO while we build the long-term automation:

1) Fast path (manual entitlement + invoice credit):
   - ResellerCo submits PO to AWS on 11/12 as planned.
   - Upon settlement, Redwood will apply agreed credits as invoice discounts for the initial term.
   - Ben will generate a manual entitlement record in our side to avoid runtime denial while billing catches up.

2) Mid path (scripted handoff):
   - ResellerCo posts a normalized webhook to your portal with PO id + AWS subscriber id; Redwood ingests and creates entitlement via our internal API.
   - Requires entity mapping early; Vanessa, can your team share the mapping format so we can validate?

3) Long path (automated entitlement in partner portal):
   - Full two-way sync (PO -> Redwood -> AWS entitlement) scheduled for Dec sprint.

Ben — I can take ownership of invoice credit application, but I need your help to create the manual entitlement record and validate the SKU mapping in the sheet.
Vanessa — can you pull together the entity/tenant mapping sample?

I'll prepare a concise runbook (one-pager) and a proposed cutover checklist for the PO on Friday.

Cheers,
Karthik
Director, Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO activation: credit mechanics + sequencing

Karthik / Alicia — I reviewed the spreadsheet and the SKU->credit buckets look fine with a couple of caveats:

- We need to normalize the sku ids (some of the reseller rows use internal shorthand). If ResellerCo can send the AWS SKU ids we can avoid mismatches.
- Manual entitlement: I can create a temporary entitlement record today that will allow live usage while the invoice credit posts. That will be tied to the customer account: 12345-ResCo-Cust.

I'll attach the provisional entitlement export once done and will copy it here. ETA: I can have the entitlement stub created and tested by 16:00 PST today.

Attachment: proposed-milestones.pdf (plan + timeline)

—Ben
Sr. Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@resellerco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO activation: credit mechanics + sequencing

Thanks — two quick notes from procurement:

- We can provide AWS SKU ids by EOD and will add the PO id in the webhook payload.
- Procurement wants a fallback in case the invoice credit misses the first billing run; can Redwood place a one-off account-level credit while teams reconcile? That would avoid a customer-facing invoice surprise.

If Ben can confirm the entitlement stub by 16:00 that would be ideal. Also, Vanessa — we can share a CSV with entity mappings; would you prefer a sample row or the full list?

Best,
Alicia

Alicia / team — quick status and finalized asks: 

- Ben has created the entitlement stub and validated against the normalized SKU list (thanks Ben).
- ResellerCo to send the CSV with AWS SKU ids + the PO id; we will hit the webhook endpoint in the mid path to validate.
- Redwood will place a one-off account-level credit if the invoice credit does not reconcile in the first billing run (we will reconcile and true-up on the next invoice).
- Deliverables by EOD Friday (11/06): runbook (one-pager), entitlement export, and a short test playbook for your procurement team to run.

Next steps: Alicia please confirm you will push the PO on 11/12 and provide the SKU csv. Vanessa — will you share the entity-mapping sample to the shared Drive link?

Thanks everyone — I'll be on standby for the cutover and will coordinate with Ops if any rollback is needed.

Best,
Karthik

Redwood Inference
